name: Identity
purpose: Own identified people and bots, their visible profiles, and the credentials that let bots authenticate.
justification: Identity is a separate boundary because actor identity and authentication are global to the application rather than owned by any conversation, and credential revocation and identity disablement must be governed before conversation-scoped authorization is evaluated.

dataObjects.name: Identity
dataObjects.purpose: Represents an identified person or bot, its visible profile, and its application access status.

dataObjects.name: Bot Credential
dataObjects.purpose: Authenticates a bot identity through revocable, expirable secret-derived credential state.

name: Discovery
purpose: Own conversation identity and lifecycle, the shared tag vocabulary, and effective tag assignments used to create, discover, and enter conversations.
justification: Discovery is a separate boundary because it governs application-wide tag meaning and privacy-sensitive listed versus unlisted lookup behavior, while conversation-scoped participation and content have different writers, authorization rules, and retained lifecycles.

dataObjects.name: Conversation
dataObjects.purpose: Represents a tagged conversation's discoverability, matching behavior, purpose, and archival lifecycle.

dataObjects.name: Tag
dataObjects.purpose: Defines a globally reusable canonical tag used to identify, discover, and join conversations.

dataObjects.name: Conversation Tag
dataObjects.purpose: Retains an ordered effective assignment between a conversation and a shared tag.

name: Participation
purpose: Own the current and historical relationship between an identity and a conversation, including role authority, joining, leaving, removal, banning, and restoration.
justification: Participation is a separate boundary because Membership is the conversation tenant and authorization boundary for ordinary use and governance, and its current state must remain consistent with temporal role history and append-only change evidence independently of actor identity, conversation discovery, or authored content.

dataObjects.name: Membership
dataObjects.purpose: Represents the retained current participation and role relationship between one identity and one conversation.

dataObjects.name: Membership Role Period
dataObjects.purpose: Preserves a time-bounded conversation role assignment for one membership.

dataObjects.name: Membership Event
dataObjects.purpose: Provides append-only explanatory evidence for a membership or role transition.

name: Content
purpose: Own participant-authored messages, retained emoji responses, and contextual notes attached to conversation work.
justification: Content is a separate boundary because participants author and interact with retained expressive content under conversation access, while its visibility, soft deletion, attribution, and potentially personal or moderator-only audiences differ from discovery configuration, participation authority, and case-governed moderation evidence.

dataObjects.name: Message
dataObjects.purpose: Retains participant-authored conversation content, attribution, and soft-deletion state.

dataObjects.name: Emoji Reaction
dataObjects.purpose: Retains an identity's emoji response to a message and its withdrawal state.

dataObjects.name: Note
dataObjects.purpose: Stores contextual content attached to exactly one conversation, message, or moderation ticket.

name: Moderation
purpose: Own reports of concerning messages, moderator enforcement decisions, and time-bounded posting restrictions.
justification: Moderation is a separate boundary because owners and administrators govern sensitive report evidence and enforcement under conversation-scoped trust, with case lineage, append-only action evidence, and fresh restriction checks that differ materially from ordinary participation and content lifecycles.

dataObjects.name: Moderation Ticket
dataObjects.purpose: Tracks a numbered participant report and its privileged review state.

dataObjects.name: Moderation Action
dataObjects.purpose: Preserves append-only evidence of an enforcement action taken by a conversation moderator.

dataObjects.name: Posting Suspension
dataObjects.purpose: Represents a moderator-imposed time-bounded restriction on one membership's ability to post.
